_genreFilterHelp: Empty array = no filter (all genres). Set to whitelist TMDB genre IDs to restrict pushes. Common: [27,53] Horror+Thriller, [28,12,878] Action+Adventure+SciFi, [27,53,28] Horror+Thriller+Action, [35,10749,18] Comedy+Romance+Drama, [16,10751] Animation+Family
_discussionGroupHelp: Discussion group linked to @absolutecinemaid channel. Used for user-submitted film/series requests (POST /api/request). Channel stays clean — only auto-pushed promos/recaps.
